intent.objective: Perform the independent G0 architecture audit of the frozen CashBooks head and return one identity-bound architecture-audit artifact.
intent.rationale: G0-12 requires an independent architectural authority to inspect the committed P0 control-plane evidence and report blocking findings before scope or phase authorization.
non_goals: Changing source, policy, schemas, ADRs, scope, or phase criteria
Starting Swift development or evaluating product UI work
Issuing or accepting any human approval
acceptance_behavior: The returned artifact is an architecture-audit for G0 with a fresh eligible architectural-authority identity.
The artifact binds audited_commit exactly to the frozen dispatch head and its Git tree recorded in the handoff metadata.
The audit covers the P0 control plane, governance evidence, ADR-0005 acceptance, G0 criteria, and deferred-scope boundaries.
The artifact reports no_blocking_findings only when its findings contain no blocking item.

invalidation_triggers: any non-evidence file changes before ingestion

behavioral_requirements: Audit is independent of all sessions recorded in agent-system/work/P0/CONSTRUCTION-LOG.md.
Audit is bound to the exact frozen commit and tree supplied in the context pack.
Returned artifact validates against architecture-audit.schema.json and contains decision coverage plus findings.
manual_checkpoints: fresh-session identity and actual model/provider must be recorded before return
definition_of_done: A fresh eligible architectural-authority session returns the typed audit artifact.
The control plane ingests it with agentctl audit ingest G0.
No blocking findings remain, or the task is explicitly escalated rather than treated as G0 evidence.

architecture_escalation_conditions: audit identifies an invariant, schema, or cross-work-package conflict
human_approval_conditions: any proposed change to scope, policy, schema, ADR, or G0 criteria
